material.title: Regulator settles foreign bribery charges with Northfield Metals for USD 210 million
material.bodyOriginal: The securities regulator announced that Northfield Metals, one of the world's largest copper producers, agreed to pay USD 210 million to resolve charges under the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act over payments to officials to secure mining licences in two African countries. The company must retain an independent compliance monitor for three years.

material.title: 欧盟理事会正式通过企业可持续发展尽职调查指令修订案
material.bodyZh: 欧盟理事会今日正式通过企业可持续发展尽职调查指令修订案。修订后，员工超过 1000 人、年营业额超过 4.5 亿欧元的企业须对其供应链中的人权和环境风险开展尽职调查，矿产与金属原料供应链被列为高风险领域。成员国须在两年内转化为国内法。

material.title: Customs agency adds two cobalt refiners to forced-labour import ban list
material.bodyOriginal: The customs agency added two cobalt refiners to the entity list under the forced labour prevention act, effective immediately. Shipments containing cobalt sulphate from the two refiners will be detained at the border unless importers prove no forced labour was involved.

material.title: 碳边境调节机制过渡期结束，铝和钢铁进口商明年起须购买证书
material.bodyZh: 根据已生效的条例，碳边境调节机制过渡期将于本年底结束。明年 1 月 1 日起，进口铝、钢铁等产品的企业须按产品隐含排放购买证书，未申报的进口商将被处罚。

material.title: 某市召开廉政教育大会，强调反腐倡廉常抓不懈
material.bodyZh: 某市今日召开廉政教育大会，传达学习有关会议精神，要求各级党员干部筑牢思想防线、严守纪律规矩，以优良作风推动各项工作。

material.title: Bank supervisor issues updated anti-money-laundering guidance for retail lenders
material.bodyOriginal: The banking supervisor published updated guidance on customer due diligence for retail lenders, covering onboarding checks and suspicious transaction reports. The guidance applies to deposit-taking institutions only.

material.title: 某区政务服务中心办公设备采购项目招标公告
material.bodyZh: 某区政务服务中心办公设备采购项目现进行公开招标，采购内容包括台式电脑、打印机等，预算 48 万元，投标截止时间为下月 5 日。

material.title: Court rules on contract dispute between two software firms under anti-bribery clause
material.bodyOriginal: A commercial court ruled in a contract dispute between two software companies, finding that an anti-bribery clause had not been breached. Neither company has mining or metals operations.
